name: Unbreakable Gear
description: Your weapons and armor never lose durability, so they never break. In return, gear costs x{{price}} to buy at Choku-Funsha. Haters' gear still wears down and breaks as normal.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Gear price
settings.help: What weapons and armor cost to buy at Choku-Funsha, at every level. x1 is the game's own price. Selling pays the game's own amount, whatever this is set to.

patches.description: Weapon and armor buy prices x{{price}}
patches.sql: UPDATE master_part SET price_s = price_s * {{price}} WHERE type IN ('PTTP_ARM', 'PTTP_HEAD', 'PTTP_BODY', 'PTTP_LEGS') AND price_s > 0;

patches.description: Your weapons and armor never lose durability (BrgGame.upk)
